neodlp.description: Cross-platform Video/Audio Downloader Desktop App based on YT-DLP with Modern UI and Browser Integration (🦭 Seal for Desktop). A desktop GUI for yt-dlp that ships a fully configured environment out of the box, including a PO Token server, JS runtime, and Aria2 for fast downloads, so you never touch the CLI. A browser extension for Chromium and Firefox lets you right-click any link and send it straight to NeoDLP.
